messages:
neha-sales: Customer (FinServeCo) POC ask: EU control plane only, inference on their Canada colo (air-gapped preferred), BYO-KMS with HSM possible, and absolutely no external egress for request payloads. Need feasibility, SOW delta, and short ops checklist by EOD.

greg-eng: Feasible with Redwood Private + customer-managed data plane. If weights must never leave, we provide an on-prem runtime bundle and a signed-artifact update path. Telemetry can be minimized to a heartbeat.

owen-sre: Network/certs: mutual TLS required. Minimal routing snippet:
```yaml
control_plane: eu-west1
data_plane: customer-onprem (ca-central1)
failover: disabled unless waiver signed
egress: allow_customer_cidrs_only: true
```
ETA: 2 days for cert rotation + runbook; +3 days for airgap installer.

tara-legal: BYOK/HSM note: HSM triggers attestation + addendum; need customer legal contact and org details to scope paperwork.

neha-sales: Pricing ask: quick ballpark so we can move forward?

greg-eng: Ballpark numbers (prelim): Private seat +$6k/mo; on-prem packaging $28k one-time; BYO-KMS integration $7k (HSM add-on +$10k); ops onboarding $4k. First-month uplift ~ $45k (HSM incl).

infra-bot: TICKET-8421 created: "finserve-poc-eu-cp-ca-onprem-byo-kms"  assignees: greg-eng, owen-sre  due: 3d.

neha-sales: Actions: 1) @greg-eng confirm signed-artifact update flow (EOD). 2) @tara-legal request customer contact + legal lead (24h). 3) @owen-sre provide cert rotation plan and minimal monitoring checklist (48h). I'll prep SOW draft with finance. :thumbsup:
